If phone_positions_diag shows a miss instead, fix the reader in tools/phone-executor/app/src/main/assets/exec.js from that dump.

observation.what: breakout_2's first clean phone Positions read after the PROP-TRACKING APK is installed (status.raw.positions_state == 'read'; overview trades measured)

origin.rerun: curl -s 'https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/prop/status?account_id=breakout_2' | jq '{ps:(.status.raw|fromjson|.positions_state), pos:(.status.raw|fromjson|.positions), diag:.phone_positions_diag}' -- holds while positions_state != "read".

what: PROP-TRACKING landed_unproven: the phone APK built from #17745 must be installed and its FIRST live Positions read observed. Until then breakout_2 per-trade uPnL is a mark ESTIMATE only, and the journal is not reconciled against the terminal (closes on the venue still write nothing back).
